claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Raclopride is a high-affinity D2/D3 dopamine receptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting off-target dopamine-receptor-independent or physicochemical effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
